text:
Jen: Quick heads-up — deploybot drafted an unpin of runtime-2.15 for prod during the night window (02:00 UTC). Want to coordinate because of longseq SDK work.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-2.15 -> target=prod; window=2026-03-24T02:00Z; canary=eu-west; prechecks=kv-cache-health,telemetry-heartbeat. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Marco: tagging @Sara @Alan — SDK longseq fix only lands in 3.1.2 tomorrow AM. If we unpin tonight, we could surface the longseq regression for some hosted customers.

Sara: Confirmed. Patch not in hosted SDK yet. We should reduce risk by routing longseq models to runtime-2.14 while the SDK rolls out.

Alan: How many affected customers in eu-west? Can we scope routing to just known customer IDs instead of model.family?

Jen: We have ~5 customers with heavy longseq traffic in eu-west. Two approaches: (1) delay unpin 12h, (2) unpin but route longseq models to 2.14, (3) unpin and put those specific customers on dedicated pool. Ops prefers #2 for speed.

Marco: Agreed on #2. Small change in deploy-configs should do it. I'll author a routing rule keyed on model.family=="longseq" for lower blast radius.

deploybot: Proposed routing snippet:
```
route_rules:
  - when: request.metadata.model_family == "longseq"
    action: route_to_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.14
    priority: 100
```

Sara: That works. Add telemetry alerts for OOMs and tail latency >2x baseline for 30m. Ops, can you create those?

ops-bot: Alert rule created: eu-west longseq tail latency > 2x baseline for 30m -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. Escalation: oncall -> SRE lead.

Alan: Also recommend gating the rollout to 20% for the first hour and include a quick release note so customer support can triage. Keep rollback plan ready.

Jen: Plan decided: A) deploy routing rule to staging, B) unpin runtime-2.15 at 02:00 UTC with rollout=20% for 1h, C) monitor alerts, D) SDK patch SDK-1129 lands tomorrow then remove rule. If alerts fire, immediate rollback to pinned runtime-2.14.

Marco: I'll push the PR to deploy-configs now and run a staging smoke.

Marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/779 — staging applied, smoke pass ok.

Sara: LGTM on PR. Ops, confirm alerts wired to the release channel.

ops-bot: Alerts verified; smoke check outputs will post to #eng-releases-metrics during rollout.

Jen: Marking this thread as :approve: for the unpin with the routing rule and 20% gated rollout. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb: "Runtime upgraded to 2.15. Long-sequence models will temporarily stay on the previous runtime until SDK patch SDK-1129 completes to avoid throughput regressions." Posting ~30m before window.

Alan: I'll be oncall during the window. Ready to trigger global rollback if we see regressions.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-2.15 -> prod at 2026-03-24T02:00Z; rollout=20%; prechecks passed.

Jen: Copy. End of thread.
